about: World 1 run length and content pacing, as data. Numbers are bot game seconds (bots.ndjson game_seconds and stages[].exit_s, fixed 90 fps), medians over the measure below. The human ledger is /mnt/project-files/world1/BUDGETS.md (owner: the World 1 integrator); this file holds the same numbers for scripts/pacing-check.mjs and the World 1 bands checker. Change a number here and in the ledger together.

measure.about: bot_args go to every run, policy_args to that policy's runs. The completionist explores until it has nothing left it can do (every site, rogue and rib cache keeps its own caps; a roll that stops closing on its goal is given up), with --explore-by=900 only as a safety clock: a park that turns at 900 s reads explore_clock_hit true in its stage note. Until 27 Oct this was --explore-by=520, which every park reached with content still open, so the old 20.8 bot-min read was that clock, not content time (ruling ag).

human_per_bot.note: Inferred, not measured. Replace with the ratio from Andrew's world 1 sitting (his run minutes over the bot median on the same build).

stages.about: Run seconds after the flume exit: transition, Brindle's fight, beats. boss.seconds is reported beside it.

reach.about: Share of runs that end stages_done (Brindle routed). Any stall fails the floor.

content.about: Optional content the completionist route spends its extra minutes on (card 2 default: mixed, a rogue, two more activities and two secrets per park). field is the per-stage key in bots.ndjson stages[]; a list counts its entries, a number is taken as is, true counts 1. A field no bot writes yet reads as pending. completionist_min is the per-run median the completionist must reach; skipper_max caps what the skipper takes (secrets must stay off the main line). bot_s is the planned bot seconds per item, for the minutes sum.

slots.owner: Run length and pacing (bot), Flume lived-in pass two, roster (packs at camps)
slots.note: Spillway secrets are cracked_cache sites, so a found secret also counts here.
